recruiting.d: The five-star corner wants a title contender, and both schools are pitching that hard. Ole Miss has the lead, Texas is right behind, and Oklahoma is still in the picture.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's playing in December? Everything else is noise.

recruiting.h: Missouri Leads for Favre, but Indiana Is Making Its Move

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

facts.d: Stanford sold him on competing for a job right away. Durante stays home in California, and family was always going to be part of the decision.

games.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls at Nebraska, and the playoff picture cracks on opening week
games.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] arrived as the nation's top team and left [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] with a loss it can't hide from. The Huskers outgained the Buckeyes 491 to 448. Tuddy_roosevelt now has to explain how his defense got outworked.

quote.text: We thought we were ready. We weren't ready for how physical they'd be.
quote.by: an Ohio State player, per a source close to the program

facts.h: Chaos: No. 1 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] goes down to [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]
facts.d: Nebraska outgained Ohio State 491 to 448. Somewhere a playoff bracket just broke.

games.h: Harrell leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a No. 25 ranking
games.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] goes from a 19-19 run at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] to a Stanford program that starts the year ranked No. 25. Players on both rosters are already deciding whether to stay.

quote.text: He sold the Stanford staff on a clean slate. Whether the roster buys it is another question.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

facts.d: H0ldStillPlease is taking over at Stanford after his run at East Carolina. He went 19-19 there. [[t:832438379|Stanford]] is 0-0 and ranked No. 25.

games.h: Nebraska went for it on fourth down, and Ohio State never recovered
games.d: The Huskers kept the punter on the bench in a 28-25 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and converted 3 of 4 tries. Each conversion drained more life from the Buckeyes' defense. Sideline chatter says that group was gassed by the end.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there you could see our guys looking at each other.
quote.by: an Ohio State defender, per a source close to the program

facts.h: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] keeps the punter on the bench in a 28-25 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]
facts.d: Nebraska converted 3 of 4 fourth downs, and each one demoralized the Ohio State defense.

cfp.method: Every remaining regular-season game is simulated 4,000 times from team ratings and scoring margin (home field worth about 2.5 points). Conference title games pit the top two in each league. A committee-style ranking weighs wins, losses, strength of schedule, conference titles and the current poll. The field is the five highest-ranked conference champions plus the next seven, with byes for the top four seeds.
